inspection_method: One-at-a-time direct creative-director review of every current canonical Firefox PNG at original resolution. No contact-sheet thumbnail, automated geometry assertion, or Chromium capture was counted as direct visual inspection.

findings: All eight diagonal window-thread compositions remain visually distinct across 520, 750, 975, and 1200 px.
Body copy, metadata, actions, and dense status text remain readable across friendly, retro, basic, and glass light/dark treatments.
The narrow Timefield vertical-label clipping found during correction review is absent from the frozen final frames.
No inspected settled frame shows clipped prose, dense-header collision, popup collision, root overflow, or an unintended mid-animation state.
All eight persistent questionnaire compositions remain structurally distinct rather than one skinned renderer.
Prompt, progress, choices, validation, navigation, cancel, skip, and commit regions remain legible and spatially resolved.
Dense variants keep choices and commit controls visible above the held composer.
Publication notes, score, time bands, revision layers, instrument bench, strands, relay zones, and quiet register remain eight distinct work compositions.
Dense headers separate label, active summary, time, and state without collision; row type and status contrast remain readable.
Persistent composer, work controls, progress, and scroll boundaries remain coherent.
Artifact error, approval and offline, durable draft, pop-out Context Lens, route picker, and all-thread search states are readable and recoverable.
The 520 px popups remain inside the viewport with visible close paths and no origin-control collision.
The prototype-only deterministic controller is clearly outside the proposed production Chat surface.
Every corrected trigger frame is visually clean and carries the exact visible trigger receipt.
Artifact, decision, history, question, subagent-spawn, thread-branch, and collision frames expose especially prominent visible consequences.

Many lifecycle frames intentionally retain the same primary composition and expose the exact bottom receipt; their required non-receipt semantic mutations are established by automated before-after assertions in the browser receipt rather than inferred from pixels alone.
system.reset visibly restores the known fixture state and retains its exact reset receipt.
scenario.reset intentionally clears trigger receipts and returns the visible fixture-ready state; the automated reset matrix proves the canonical fingerprint twice.

correction_findings: Correction review exposed an earlier retained-focus/compositor evidence issue and narrow Timefield label clipping; both were fixed before the frozen final capture.

Provider supply-chain, authentication-order, and continuation-currentness corrections changed the frozen source fingerprint; all 115 regenerated Firefox canonical frames were then re-opened and inspected at original resolution.
No remaining visual defect was found in the inspected final set.
evidence_boundaries: The 512 baseline cells, 896 feature-state cells, 432 continuous-resize cells, and other large matrices are automated geometry and semantic-state checks, not individual human image reviews.
Chromium produced 115 current frames and passed the same complete 33-check suite from a file URL, but those Chromium frames are not included in this direct-inspection claim.
Browser evidence does not establish native Slint rendering, detached-window DPI, platform font metrics, IME, assistive-technology behavior, or live-service behavior.
residual_boundary: This receipt covers visual judgment of the browser concept evidence only. The implementation is HTML/CSS/JavaScript with Slint-portable translation guidance; it is not native, compiled, drop-in, or production-validated Slint.
